name: unrehearsed-2026-10-03
_note: SF-CMD-1 held-out census, written blind on Oct 3, 2026 from the verb families alone; 150 orders + 150 questions, each with its intended reading; never edited after the run.

intended.note: Ney attacks Mack at Swabia from Rhineland, with the muster and objection seams as usual.
Lower case changes nothing: Ney attacks Mack.
A march into an enemy-held province with Mack standing on it should engage or warn, never silently walk in.
Soult marches from Lorraine to Rhineland; the politeness is noise.
A standing PURSUE on Mack; Murat closes from Franche-Comte.
Lannes scouts Swabia if it is in his scout range, else refused with the range named.
Ney takes a defensive stance at Rhineland.
Davout digs in at Rhineland; Iron Resolve begins coiling.
Bernadotte drills at Franconia; refused only if an enemy is in reach.
A free retreat from Milan toward Piedmont.
A standing SUPPORT order at 1 action; Lannes marches toward Ney's guns.
